Phase-typed Lucene runtime holder-swap and drain stress coverage

Lane F stage A item A12. Two wall-clock-bound tests against the in-process index half. (1) EngineFileLockContentionTest (the converted WindowsTortureTest): its instrument, FileIntruder, promises 10-50ms lock holds; on a machine saturated by a concurrent whole-repo build the holding threads are not scheduled to release on time and the writer starves, so the test stops measuring survival and starts measuring machine load. Measured 2026-09-07: passes in ~10s under :modules:app-engine:test, blew its 180s liveness budget on both methods during a concurrent ./gradlew test. Quarantined at full assertion strength rather than given a longer budget. (2) EngineExtractionSandboxChaosTest (the converted in-process half of the retired ExtractionSandboxChaosTest): it wedges an extraction child for a whole 60s TimeboxedContentExtractor deadline and then exhausts a child heap, so it runs for minutes BY CONSTRUCTION -- not because the machine is loaded. Either way the default inner loop is the wrong tier for it.
